yo.name: YO Protocol (yoETH vault)

token.src: @yo-protocol/core SDK constant YO_TOKEN; docs.yo.xyz FAQ (FDV $90M / $0.09 reference)

yo.status: TOKEN LIVE (not a future airdrop). $YO launched Jan 29 2026 with Heat 1 of the rewards program; Genesis airdrop (8% of 1B) was claimable Feb 5 - May 6 2026 (closed). YO says Genesis 'will be the last airdrop'. Since then $YO is streamed to depositors through Merkl (30% of supply reserved for community rewards); unclaimed Merkl rewards may be reassigned after 90 days. $YO is non-transferable until a governance vote; no market price exists.
yo.points_program: YO Points (2025, base multiplier 3x that declined as TVL grew; DeFi-activity multipliers 4-5x for Pendle/Balancer) converted into the Genesis airdrop. Replaced by $YO rewards 'Heats'.
yo.user_rank_source: The public all-time $YO rewards leaderboard (api.yo.xyz/api/v1/rewards/all-time/<YO token>) matches 'rank 200-300 with under 10,000': on 2026-10-11 rank 200 = ~12,064 YO, rank 250 = ~8,763 YO, rank 300 = ~6,794 YO, out of 5,087 wallets and ~31.39M YO total. The leaderboard ranks CLAIMED $YO (it matched Merkl 'claimed' exactly in a test), so unclaimed rewards do not count until claimed.

public: api.yo.xyz all-time and weekly $YO rewards leaderboard (rank, amount, total users)
yoETH balance on Base/Ethereum via public RPC (ERC-4626 balanceOf + convertToAssets)

evidence.text: Genesis airdrop: 8% of 1B $YO; claims Feb 5 - May 6 2026; 'the last airdrop for the YO community'

townsquare.name: TownSquare
townsquare.chain: Monad (lending), deposits also on BNB Chain (USD1, U) and Base (USDC)

token.premarket_src: Aspecta pre-TGE price as reported by BingX news (unverified secondary source)

townsquare.status: PRE-TGE. $TOWN public sale on Sonar (Echo) closed Jul 27 2026 (2.01x oversubscribed, tiers at $150M and $200M FDV). Tokenomics published (indicative). TGE date NOT announced; third-party calendars say 'Q4 2026 (estimated)'. Points docs say points carry 'no right to any token distribution', but the tokenomics say part of the 31.84% community pool 'becomes available early to reward existing users that participated in the protocol before it became popular', and the app's referral page already describes '$TOWN token reward' claims.
townsquare.points_program: TownSquare Points, Season 01 leaderboard at app.townsq.xyz/ranking: lending/borrowing MON, MON LSTs, stables (USD1, AUSD, USDC, earnAUSD, USDT), RWAs, wBTC/wETH; deposits of U/USD1 on BNB, USDC on Base, AUSD on Monad. +20% boosted wallets, +15% boost for all users when the in-app TVL milestone ($125M) is reached; 2.5% referral kickback of $TOWN rewards.
townsquare.tvl_note: DefiLlama tracks only the Monad lending + loop vaults: ~$0.21M TVL and ~$0.34M borrowed on 2026-10-11 (peak ~$3.6M in Jan 2026). The ~$100M figure you see is not on DefiLlama: the app sums its own deposits + vaults + RWA vaults toward a $125M milestone, and TownSquare announced a '$100M USD1 liquidity program' on May 14 2026. Treat the in-app number as unaudited.

login: Your points and rank: /api/points/* requires a Bearer token from a wallet-signature login (SIWE). Cannot be read with just an address; enter your points/rank by hand from app.townsq.xyz/ranking.

evidence.text: $TOWN public sale on Sonar ended, 2.01x oversubscribed; distribution on token-launch day (200M tier) or after lockup (150M tier)

Tokenomics: 10B supply; community airdrop & ve-incentives 31.84% (3.184B), 5.83% of it unlocked at TGE (~185.6M TOWN = 1.86% of supply), 84-month vesting for the rest; 'a portion becomes available early to reward existing users'
Points docs: 'Points are non-transferable activity records with no monetary value and no right to any token distribution. Any future benefit is discretionary.'
